fullPassage: Sensory nerves have specialized endings in the tissues that pick up a particular sensation. If, for example, you step on a sharp object such as a pin, nerve endings in the skin will transmit the pain sensation up your leg, up and along the spinal cord to the brain. While the pain itself is unpleasant, it is in fact acting as a protective mechanism for the foot. That is, you get used to the pain so the capacity with which you can avoid pain decreases. Within the brain, nerves will connect to the area that controls speech, so that you may well shout 'ouch' or something rather less polite. They will also connect to motor nerves that travel back down the spinal cord, and to the muscles in your leg that now contract quickly to lift your foot away from the painful object. Sensory and motor nerves control almost all functions in the body — from the beating of the heart to the movement of the gut, sweating and just about everything else.

det.analysis: specialize(동사, 특화하다) → specialized(과거분사형 형용사, 특화된). 뒤의 명사 endings(말단)를 꾸며주는 형태가 필요해요. '~된'이라는 뜻으로 명사를 꾸미려면 과거분사(-ed)로 바꿉니다.
det.tip: specialize(특화하다) → specialized(특화된). 명사 endings를 수식하는 분사형 형용사

questions.passage: Sensory nerves have specialized endings in the tissues that pick up a particular sensation. If, for example, you step on a sharp object such as a pin, nerve endings in the skin will transmit the pain sensation up your leg, up and along the spinal cord to the brain. While the pain itself is unpleasant, it is in fact acting as a protective mechanism for the foot. That is, you get used to the pain so the capacity with which you can avoid pain decreases. Within the brain, nerves will connect to the area that __________, so that you may well shout 'ouch' or something rather less polite. They will also connect to motor nerves that travel back down the spinal cord, and to the muscles in your leg that now contract quickly to lift your foot away from the painful object. Sensory and motor nerves control almost all functions in the body — from the beating of the heart to the movement of the gut, sweating and just about everything else.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.analysis:
① controls speech: 바로 뒤에 'ouch'라고 소리친다는 내용이 나오므로 '언어를 통제하는' 영역이어야 함 ←정답

② stops breathing(호흡을 멈추다): 소리치는 것과 무관

③ stores memory(기억을 저장하다): 발화와 무관

④ controls vision(시각을 통제하다): 말하기가 아니라 보기이므로 부적절
det.tip: shout 'ouch' = 소리치다 → 언어(speech)를 통제하는 영역

questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.analysis:
① growth of hair(머리카락 성장): 신경이 즉각 통제하는 기능이 아님

② movement of the gut: 심장 박동과 나란히 제시되는 신체 '기능'으로, 신경이 통제하는 '장의 운동'이 적절 ←정답

③ color of the eyes(눈 색깔): 신경이 통제하는 기능이 아님

④ length of bones(뼈 길이): 신경이 통제하는 기능이 아님
det.tip: from the beating of the heart to the movement of the gut = 심장 박동부터 장의 운동까지
